lines.en: I decide to spend the night at the bar talking to Sara.
lines.zh: 我决定今晚就泡在酒吧里，陪 Sara 说说话。

lines.en: Sana is hanging out with Ayane tonight, so the two of us actually get to talk one-on-one for a change.
lines.zh: Sana 今晚去找 Ayane 玩了，所以我俩这回总算能难得地一对一聊一次。

lines.en: Of course, talking turns to flirting relatively quickly as Sara proceeds to not hold anything back whatsoever.
lines.zh: 当然了，聊天很快就变成了调情——Sara 一如既往地毫无保留。

lines.en: I want to say that she wouldn't be acting this way if there were any other customers in the bar, but I'm starting to believe that might not be the case at all.
lines.zh: 我本想说，要是店里还有别的客人，她总不至于这样；可我开始觉得，恐怕根本不是那么回事。

lines.en: And even though I can't quite figure out why she likes me as much as she appears to, I'm not about to deny the undivided attention of an adorable MILF.
lines.zh: 虽然我始终搞不明白她为什么这么喜欢我，但一位可爱的熟女愿意把注意力全放在我身上，我可不会拒绝。

lines.en: Sara winds up drinking a bit too much during our conversation and starts dozing off before the bar is even shut down for the night.
lines.zh: 聊着聊着 Sara 喝得有点多，酒吧还没打烊她就打起瞌睡来了。

lines.en: I do her a favor and turn the sign outside to 'closed' and help carry her up the stairs and into bed.
lines.zh: 我帮了她一把，把外面的牌子翻成「已打烊」，再把她抱上楼、塞进被窝。

lines.en: She invites me to sleep over and tries to take my pants off, but she's so drunk at this point that I can't bring myself to go any further.
lines.zh: 她邀我留下来过夜，还动手想脱我裤子；可她这时已经醉成那样，我实在没法再往下进行。

lines.en: Having been defeated by my own morals (Which apparently still exist), I tuck her into bed and begin the journey home...
lines.zh: 败给了自己的道德底线（看来它还在），我把她安顿好，然后踏上回家的路……

lines.en: I then proceed to warm up some milk for her and tuck her in because I am kind and I want her to feel cherished.
lines.zh: 于是我又给她热了杯牛奶，把她塞回被窝——因为我是个好人，我想让她觉得自己被珍惜着。
Sara 的好感度提升到了 [sara_love]!
